question: a prospective replication of US_INSIDER_BUY (counted test 26: open-market purchases by officers or directors, USD 50k or more, no 10b5-1 plan; 20-session excess +1.01%, t 2.83; 60-session +1.80%, t 2.87; survivor-only, LEAN_WITHOUT_SIZE): does the 20-session plan beat matched twins on events defined exactly as test 26 did, in the market as it is now?
event: a Form 4 (EDGAR form type exactly '4'; '4/A' is not used) whose XML has at least one purchase line: a nonDerivativeTransaction with transactionCode 'P', transactionAcquiredDisposedCode 'A', a security title that research/US_INSIDER_BUY/ib_lib.is_common accepts, shares > 0 and price per share > 0; a reporting owner who is an officer or a director (isOfficer or isDirector true; 10% owners or 'other' only are not events); no 10b5-1 flag (an aff10b5One element equal to 1 or true excludes the filing); purchase lines totalling at least USD 50,000 (shares x price)
source: the EDGAR daily form index https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/daily-index/<YYYY>/QTR<q>/form.<YYYYMMDD>.idx (form type '4' lines; sha256 recorded) for each NYSE session date not yet covered by an earlier FORM4 batch, from the window start; each listed filing's full text https://www.sec.gov/Archives/<File Name> (the XML inside, sha256 recorded); a date whose index is not yet published is left for the next batch
public_date: the filing date of the index (the data sets carry no acceptance time; as test 26)
batches: every batch is recorded, also an empty one: the index dates read, the Form 4 filings read and their statuses (SEALED, or SKIP_NOT_PURCHASE grouped as counts, SKIP_NO_TICKER, SKIP_NOT_IN_UNIVERSE, SKIP_NOT_OPERATING, SKIP_REPEAT_90D, SKIP_LATE); only filings that are purchase events are listed one by one, the others are counted by reason

issuer.universe: a ticker of the issuer CIK (company_tickers_exchange.json, sha256 recorded per batch), the first in SEC order that is fresh and eligible in the US paper scan of the signal session (else SKIP_NOT_IN_UNIVERSE; no ticker: SKIP_NO_TICKER); an operating issuer by catalysts.is_operating (a 10-K, 10-Q, 20-F or 40-F in 550 days, no fund report; else SKIP_NOT_OPERATING)
issuer.repeat: a set of this family on the same issuer sealed in the 90 calendar days before (the chain starts at the window start, so the first 90 days have a shorter history than test 26's) -> SKIP_REPEAT_90D; several qualifying filings of one issuer on one date are one event (the first by accession number, the values summed)

timing.entry_session: the first NYSE session whose 09:15 New York time is after the sealing time (catalysts.NYSE_HOLIDAYS, 2026-2027)
timing.signal_session: the NYSE session before the entry session; the US paper scan of that session must exist
timing.entry_cutoff: 09:15 New York time of the entry session; a set sealed later is refused
timing.late: a filing date before the signal session -> SKIP_LATE (the register missed the session the plan would have entered)

plan.exit: the close of the 20th session after entry
plan.costs: the US profile's fees and cost tiers (EXEC-US-v1)

coverage: every sealed set is FIRE (a replication of test 26's event definition, no new filter); descriptive tags: total purchase value, number of owners, a top-executive title (ib_lib's _TOP pattern on the officer title), the days from the last transaction to the filing
twins: speculation.draw_twins on the signal session's US features, excluding the batch's event tickers and the scan's candidates, seeded as above; taken in that order, a name is a twin if it is an operating issuer and has no original Schedule 13D in the 90 days before sealing (as SEC13D); at most 15 checked; the first 5 that pass. Twins are not screened for insider purchases (that would need every twin's Form 4 history)

cone.statement: the plan's net return is above the twins' median net return
the plan's net return after costs is above zero
the plan's net return is at or below -10%
a close in the 20 sessions after the signal session is at least 1.30 x the signal close

decision.sample: sets of this family, window H20, RESOLVED with a paired difference

MEAN.what: per-session mean of (plan net - twins' mean net), one-sided t against 0
MEAN.eligible_extra: the plan's mean net after costs > 0

WIN_RATE.what: per-session share of sets beating the twins' median (BEATS_TWINS_20), one-sided t against 0.5
WIN_RATE.eligible_extra: the plan's mean net after costs > 0

looks.source: the same design as research/CATALYST_REGISTER_v1/prereg_2.json (Lan-DeMets O'Brien-Fleming-type spending at 60/120/240 with the t >= 3.0 floor, then t >= 3.0)

at_a_look.eligible: t >= that look's t_min, one-sided p < 0.05, estimate > 0, and the primary's eligible_extra
at_a_look.futility: from the 240 look on, a primary whose estimate is <= 0 stops: FAIL (futility)
at_a_look.fail: a primary not eligible at the 1920 look fails
at_a_look.confirmed: eligible at a look and at the next look
at_a_look.family: the family stops when both primaries have stopped

forbidden: changing a rule after the first set of this family is sealed
any order, any change to PAPER-POLICY-v4 or ledger.jsonl
